sentences.en: We need to do the pre-booking for our trip next month.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为下个月的旅行提前预定。

sentences.en: You can save money by doing a pre-booking for the concert tickets.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过提前预定音乐会门票来省钱。

sentences.en: Make sure to check if they accept pre-bookings for last-minute bookings too.
sentences.zh: 确保确认他们是否也接受最后一分钟预订的预订。
